attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Oklahoma state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "OK Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get apportionment.state_code get 'OK' eq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus get apportionment.state_code get 'OK' eq and

action_details.action_postfix:
# Oklahoma filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). # # Reference: Oklahoma Form 512 Instructions (Corporation Income Tax Return) # Reference: 68 Okla. Stat. § 2355 et seq. (Corporate Income Tax) # Reference: OAC 710:50-17-3 (What constitutes "Nexus")
"OK filing required - physical nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

# Oklahoma filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). # Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions # # Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) # Reference: Oklahoma Tax Commission Economic Nexus Guidance
"OK filing required - economic nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

# No Oklahoma nexus - no filing requirement. # Any estimated payments would be refunded.
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"OK - no nexus, no filing required" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Oklahoma state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "OK Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate OK state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix:
# Oklahoma state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. # # Additions may include: # - Interest on U.S. government obligations (OAC 710:50-17-51) # - State income tax refunds included in federal income # - IRC Section 199A deduction addback (depending on OK conformity) # - State income taxes deducted on federal return # # Subtractions may include: # - Interest on Oklahoma state and municipal obligations (OAC 710:50-17-51) # - Dividends from affiliated corporations (68 Okla. Stat. § 2357) # - Income from U.S. obligations (if included in federal) # # Reference: Oklahoma Form 512 Schedule B (Additions and Subtractions) # Reference: OAC 710:50-17-51 (Adjustments to arrive at Oklahoma taxable income) # Reference: 68 Okla. Stat. § 2355 et seq.
0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"OK income adjustments calculated" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"OK - no nexus, no adjustments" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Oklahoma state corporate income tax. Applies 4% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "OK State Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate OK tax at 4% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix:
# Oklahoma state corporate income tax calculation: # # 1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] # 2. Apportioned to OK: × [Apportionment % using single-sales factor] # 3. State additions: + [Additions from Schedule B] # 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions from Schedule B] # 5. OK taxable income: = [Result] # 6. OK tax rate: × 4.0% # 7. OK income tax: = [Tax before credits] # 8. OK credits: - [Credits from Schedule C] # 9. OK tax liability: = [Final tax] # # Oklahoma uses 100% single-sales factor apportionment. # Tax rate is a flat 4% with no brackets or alternative minimum tax. # # Available OK credits include: # - Investment/New Jobs Tax Credit (68 Okla. Stat. § 2357.21) # - Small Employer Quality Jobs Incentive Act Credit # - Historic Preservation Tax Credit # - Research and Development Tax Credit # - Venture Capital Tax Credit # - Oklahoma Quality Events Incentive Act Credit # # Reference: Oklahoma Form 512 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions # Reference: Oklahoma Form 512 Schedule C (Tax Credits) # Reference: 68 Okla. Stat. § 2355 (4% tax rate) # Reference: 68 Okla. Stat. § 2358 (Apportionment - single-sales factor) # Reference: OAC 710:50-17 (Corporate Income Tax)
apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.ok_state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"OK tax calculated: $" apportionment.state_tax get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

# No Oklahoma taxable income - no tax liability. # Oklahoma allows NOL carryforward (68 Okla. Stat. § 2357.6).
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"OK - nexus but no taxable income" job.audit_trail swap addto

# No Oklahoma nexus - no tax liability. # Any estimated payments are refunded.
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"OK - no nexus, no tax liability" job.audit_trail swap addto
